entry.zh: 站点登录 → 右上角头像 → 家庭管理
entry.en: Site sign-in → avatar → 家庭管理 (Household management)

prerequisite.zh: 准备两个独立演示账号；不要使用真实邀请链接或其他家庭资料。
prerequisite.en: Use two independent demo identities; never publish real invitation links or other households’ data.

zh: 用自己的ChatGPT账号登录；未加入家庭时先核对邀请来源。
管理员打开家庭管理，确认家庭名称，点击“生成邀请链接”；只私下发给对应家人。
家人打开邀请，用自己的账号登录，核对家庭名称后点击“确认加入家庭”。
回到成员表确认管理员/只读身份；在“家庭记账成员”添加昵称，必要时关联已加入账号。
需要变更权限时选择“移除成员”“转移管理”或成员自己的“退出家庭”，阅读确认说明再提交。
en: Sign in with your own ChatGPT account; verify the invitation source if not yet a member.
The administrator opens Household management, confirms the household name, and chooses 生成邀请链接 (Generate invitation). Send it privately to the intended person.
The recipient signs in separately, checks the household name, and chooses 确认加入家庭 (Join household).
Check administrator/read-only roles. Add bookkeeping nicknames under 家庭记账成员 and optionally link existing signed-in members.
For removal, transfer, or leaving, select the corresponding member action and read the confirmation before submitting.

result.zh: 登录成员能查看本家庭，普通成员不能一般财务写入，但可以提交本人预算意见。昵称不是登录权限；管理权转移不改变历史资产归属。
result.en: Members can read their own household. Ordinary members cannot make general financial changes but can submit their own budget opinions. Nicknames grant no access; management transfer does not change historical asset ownership.

note.zh: 邀请一次使用、7天有效，可撤销；泄露有效邀请可能让持有人加入。管理员须先转移管理再退出。截图待补：当前无可公开的完整邀请与第二真实账号演示图。
note.en: Invitations are single-use, expire after seven days, and can be revoked. A leaked active link may let its holder join. Administrators must transfer management before leaving. Screenshot gap: no publishable complete invitation/real-second-user sequence is available.

title.en: Connect ChatGPT and check the current session

entry.zh: 头像 → 工作流集成；ChatGPT → 已连接应用
entry.en: Avatar → 工作流集成 (Workflow integration); connected apps in ChatGPT

prerequisite.zh: 网站账号与ChatGPT会话连接分别验证；插件注册和分发尚有外部环节。
prerequisite.en: Verify website identity and the ChatGPT connection separately; plugin registration/distribution still has external dependencies.

zh: 打开“工作流集成”，阅读插件接入说明；没有实际安装入口时由维护者完成分发，不猜插件地址。
点击“检查本站连接”，核对当前账号、家庭、权限及业务工作流数量。
在已连接的ChatGPT新会话说“检查家庭财务中心连接”，让助手核对该会话的连接状态。
连接有效后说“先读取已有数据，帮我规划……”；网页准备过任务时说“继续网站中准备的任务”。
手机/iPad使用实际可用的已连接会话；电脑端旧技能安装入口仅供已有MCP的Codex环境。
en: Open Workflow integration and read the connection instructions. If no real installation entry is available, the maintainer must complete distribution; do not invent a plugin URL.
Choose 检查本站连接 (Check this site), then inspect the account, household, role, and workflow availability.
In a new connected ChatGPT conversation, ask “Check my Family Finance Center connection” to verify that conversation separately.
Once connected, ask it to read existing data before planning. For a task prepared on the site, ask it to continue the prepared task.
On phones/iPads use an actually available connected conversation. The legacy desktop skill installer is only for Codex environments with MCP already configured.

result.zh: 本站检查不读余额或流水、不修改账本；网页通过不能替另一会话承诺安装成功。当前七个业务入口，连接检查属于附加能力。
result.en: The site check does not expose balances/transactions or change the ledger. A website success cannot certify another conversation’s installation. There are seven business entry points, with a separate connection-check capability.

note.zh: S09为本地新增界面，不证明已上线、已进插件目录或真实iPad安装成功。401后重新登录并重新检查，不保留旧成功结论。
note.en: S09 shows a local addition, not proof of deployment, directory publication, or real iPad installation. After a 401, sign in and check again rather than trusting an old success.

title.zh: 从空账本完成家庭建档

entry.zh: 财务总览 → 开始家庭财务建档；已有家庭从工作流集成继续
entry.en: 财务总览 (Overview) → 开始家庭财务建档; existing households continue through integration

prerequisite.zh: 管理员；先收集演示资产余额和核对日期，未知不要填0。
prerequisite.en: Administrator access; prepare demo balance snapshots and dates. Unknown does not mean zero.

zh: 进入建档，先让ChatGPT读取已有成员、类别、资产、目标和草稿，列出缺项。
逐轮提供一两项已知资料：称呼/归属、类别、现有资产负债及余额日期、目标、固定收支；允许跳过。
ChatGPT提交建档配置或已有资产草稿；回“研究记录”逐项检查，已有资产勾选确认持有事实后采用。
每段采用后重新读取真实成员/账户ID，再继续依赖这些记录的下一段。
银行真实余额为0可以登记；缺失余额保留未知，不重建覆盖已有账本。
en: Ask ChatGPT to read existing members, types, assets, goals, and drafts, then identify missing information.
Provide one or two known details at a time: names/ownership, types, existing assets and debts with snapshot dates, goals, and recurring items. Skip unknowns.
Submit setup or existing-asset drafts, review each under Research records, and explicitly confirm actual ownership before adoption.
Read newly saved member/account IDs after each adopted stage before creating dependent records.
A genuinely confirmed zero bank balance is valid. Leave unknown balances unresolved and never reinitialize an existing ledger.

result.zh: 已有资产以开账记录，不是新增收入或新买入；登记1000元已有银行余额，余额为1000元，不再产生一笔向银行充值。
result.en: Existing assets are opening balances, not new income or purchases. Opening a confirmed CNY1,000 bank balance yields CNY1,000, not another top-up.

note.zh: 家庭管理的JSON初始化仅适用于空账本和已核对资料；普通用户优先逐段建档，不把别人备份或截图转录当初始化数据。
note.en: JSON initialization under household management is only for an empty ledger and reviewed inputs. Prefer staged onboarding; never initialize from someone else’s backup or screenshot transcription.

title.zh: 阅读总览、隐私模式与成员筛选
title.en: Read the overview, privacy mode, and member filters

entry.zh: 财务总览；顶部眼睛与成员筛选
entry.en: 财务总览 (Overview); top privacy toggle and member filters

prerequisite.zh: 已有资产/规则时读数据；空家庭会显示建档空态。
prerequisite.en: Use recorded assets/rules where available; an empty household shows onboarding.

zh: 先看总资产、总负债、净资产和人民币现金，确认它们代表不同口径。
点击顶部“显示金额”查看演示数值，再点击隐藏；切换栏目后核对当前选择。
选择全家汇总、家庭共用或某位成员，核对资产归属范围，不把共用和汇总当同义词。
展开目标与备款说明，比较用户目标、当前积累、未付计划与银行现金；再看实际/预计周期变化。
遇到缺汇率、缺期初、余额日期不足或待核对提示时，先补资料，不自行把未知补成0。
en: Read assets, liabilities, net worth, and CNY cash as separate measures.
Use 显示金额 (Show amounts) for demo values, then hide them; check the current choice after navigating.
Select all-household, shared, or individual ownership; shared and aggregate are different scopes.
Inspect goals and funding explanations, then distinguish actual accumulation from recurring forecasts.
When exchange rates, opening history, or snapshot dates are missing, resolve the inputs rather than substituting zero.

result.zh: 显示与筛选只改变视图，不写流水。刷新/重新打开默认隐藏金额；编辑输入仍可能显示原值。证券和养老金不等于可花银行现金。
result.en: Display and filters do not post transactions. Reloading hides amounts by default; editing fields may still show their original values. Securities and pensions are not spendable bank cash.

note.zh: S01是空态示例，不展示完整持仓后的总览。完整数据总览截图待补；隐私模糊不能替代权限控制。
note.en: S01 illustrates the empty state, not a populated overview. A safe populated screenshot is still needed. Privacy blur does not replace authorization.

title.zh: 资产分类、银行账户、内部转账与归档
title.en: Asset types, bank accounts, transfers, and archiving

entry.zh: 资产与贷款 → 管理资产类型 / 账户行操作
entry.en: 资产与贷款 (Assets and loans) → 管理资产类型 / row actions

prerequisite.zh: 管理员；已有资产走建档，实际资金变动走专用操作。
prerequisite.en: Administrator access; existing assets use onboarding, actual cash movements use dedicated actions.

zh: 通过ChatGPT登记已有账户，核对成员、币种和余额日期；回研究记录采用后在资产表找到记录。
用归属成员、持有账户和分类筛选定位；缺估值时读“待折算”，不要把合计当完整数。
点击“管理资产类型”，新增或改名、启用；核对账户性质，保存后返回资产表。
同币种银行账户之间已发生转账时，在转出行点“内部转账”，选转入成员与账户，填实际金额、日期和说明，确认到账。
零余额/清仓账户需查历史时勾选“显示清零与归档账户（保留历史）”；只在满足条件时归档。
en: Register an existing account through ChatGPT, review ownership, currency, and snapshot date, then locate it in the asset table after adoption.
Filter by member, holding account, or asset type. Treat missing conversions as incomplete totals.
Choose 管理资产类型 (Manage types), add or rename/enable a type, verify its accounting nature, and save.
For a completed same-currency transfer, choose 内部转账 on the source row, select the destination member/account, and record the actual amount, date, and explanation.
Enable 显示清零与归档账户 to inspect cleared/archived history. Archive only when allowed.

result.zh: 改分类名不改余额；类型性质创建后不能改，仍被账户或目标引用时不能停用。内部转账只移动资金，不产生家庭收入。
result.en: Renaming types does not alter balances. Accounting nature is fixed; referenced types cannot be disabled. Transfers move funds without creating household income.

note.zh: S10保留旧版页顶草稿区，当前草稿统一在研究记录；S11只展示类型维护表单。归档保留历史，不能用来抹掉欠款。
note.en: S10 includes an older page-top draft panel; current drafts are centralized under Research records. S11 shows the type editor. Archiving preserves history and cannot erase debt.

title.zh: 设置自由组合资产目标

prerequisite.zh: 管理员；确认要计入目标的真实资产类型。
prerequisite.en: Administrator access; identify the exact asset types included in each goal.

zh: 打开目标设置，读取现有组合，区分已保存目标与旧默认参考值。
点“增加目标组合”，填写名称和人民币目标金额，展开类型选择并勾选范围。
其他组合使用不同类型，不把同一类型重复计入两个目标；新类别不会自动进目标。
按需填每月积累与目标日期，未知可留空；旧版本切换时核对完整替换范围并确认。
点击“保存资产目标”，回总览比较范围、总目标、完成额和月目标。
en: Open Goals and distinguish saved household goals from legacy reference defaults.
Choose 增加目标组合, enter a name and CNY target, then select included asset types.
Use disjoint types across goals. New types are not automatically included.
Optionally set a monthly target and date. For a legacy conversion, review the complete replacement scope and confirm.
Choose 保存资产目标 and compare the scope, target, current value, and monthly progress on the overview.

result.zh: 修改目标不改变银行或持仓。未勾选资产不计进度；整体养老金与底层产品按去重规则统计，不能叠加。
result.en: Goal changes do not change cash or holdings. Unselected assets do not contribute; pension account and underlying products must not be counted twice.

note.zh: 公开可用目标截图仍包含旧个人参数来源，本版不收录。当前有完整文字步骤和独立案例，清洁截图待补。
note.en: Available goal screenshots retain values derived from older personal settings and are excluded here. Written steps and independent cases are complete; a clean screenshot is still needed.

title.zh: 记录基金股票买入、增持、部分卖出与清仓
title.en: Record securities purchases, additions, partial sales, and liquidation

entry.zh: 资产与贷款 → 记录基金买入/记录股票买入；持仓行 → 买入/卖出/赎回/清仓
entry.en: Assets and loans → purchase buttons; holding row → buy / sell / redeem / liquidate

prerequisite.zh: 交易已在机构完成，银行余额未重复包含；有同币种真实现金账户。
prerequisite.en: The institutional trade is completed and not already included in the snapshot; a matching cash account exists.

zh: 首次买入点顶部基金/股票买入，或在已有持仓行点“买入”；核对持仓、成员及分类。
选资金成员与同币种银行账户，填写实际成交总额、手续费、数量和成交日期。
先读银行现金影响，确认实际成交及余额未重复包含，再保存。
部分卖出从“卖出/赎回”核对本次数量、对应账面金额、实际回款和费用；未到账不提前记银行现金。
全部清仓选择“清仓”，核对服务器带出的完整账面与已知数量、净到账；保存后查看历史，再确认零持仓可见性。
en: For a first purchase use the fund/stock purchase button; for an addition use 买入 on the existing holding.
Select the paying member and same-currency bank account; enter actual gross consideration, fees, quantity, and trade date.
Read the cash-impact preview and confirm the completed trade is not already covered before saving.
For a partial sale/redeem, supply the quantity, carrying amount, actual proceeds, and fees. Do not credit cash before settlement.
For liquidation, verify the complete server-derived carrying amount/known quantity and net proceeds, then inspect preserved history after saving.

result.zh: 买入扣成交额加费用；清仓增加成交额减费用。实际交易记录不是OPENING；不自动换汇、不向券商下单。
result.en: Purchases debit consideration plus fees; liquidation credits consideration minus fees. Trade records are not opening balances. The app neither converts currency nor sends orders.

note.zh: 报价不是成交价；数量未知不得用本次买入量冒充全部持仓。S12为模拟清仓表单，图片参数与案例参数独立。
note.en: Quotes are not execution prices. Unknown total quantity cannot be replaced with one new lot. S12 is a demo liquidation form with parameters independent of the cases.

title.zh: 贷款资料、还贷模拟、未来预算与实际还款
title.en: Loan details, simulation, future budgets, and actual repayment

entry.zh: 资产与贷款 → 贷款行“调整/还贷测算/记录还款”；预算页 → 登记未来提前还款预算
entry.en: Loan row → edit / simulation / record repayment; budgets → future early-repayment budget

prerequisite.zh: 贷款本金、利率、起止日期和银行记录已核对；模拟与记账分开。
prerequisite.en: Verified principal, rates, dates, and bank records; simulation is separate from posting.

zh: 在贷款行调整已知利率、起止日和月供资料，未知项留空。
点“还贷测算”，填写剩余期数、拟还本金与方案，计算后比较月供或期限，不保存为实际还款。
要备款时到预算页“登记未来提前还款预算”，填计划日期、预计金额和可选本金/利息，确认尚未发生。
银行实际扣款后回“记录还款”，选付款账户，分别填实际本金和利息、日期与核对说明。
确认后查看现金流水、银行余额和剩余贷款；部分还款核对计划仍需备款。
en: Edit known rate, start/end dates, and installment details; leave unknown fields blank.
Use 还贷测算, enter remaining installments and proposed principal, then compare payment/term scenarios without posting.
For funding preparation, create a future early-repayment budget with a date, estimated amount, and optional principal/interest, confirming it has not occurred.
After the bank debits the payment, use 记录还款 and enter the paying account, actual principal, interest, date, and explanation separately.
Inspect cashflow, bank balance, and remaining principal; partial repayment must leave any outstanding plan funding visible.

result.zh: 模拟和未来预算不减少本金或银行现金。实际本金100元、利息10元时现金减110元、贷款本金减100元，利息另列。
result.en: Simulation and future budgets do not debit cash or principal. For CNY100 principal and CNY10 interest, cash falls by110 and debt principal by100; interest is separate.

note.zh: 截图待补：当前没有经过公开资料检查的完整贷款模拟与还款画面。银行预约不是实际扣款。
note.en: Screenshot gap: no reviewed full loan simulation/repayment image is available. A bank reservation is not an actual payment.

title.zh: 养老金充值、内部投资、赎回与分类
title.en: Pension funding, internal investment, redemption, and classification

entry.zh: 资产与贷款 → 持有账户/更多操作 → 账户明细、账户内买入、账户内赎回、调整分类
entry.en: Assets and loans → holding account/more actions → pension details, buy, redeem, classify

prerequisite.zh: 管理员；核对同成员银行账户、年度已缴、内部资金和产品快照。
prerequisite.en: Administrator; verify ownership, annual contributions, internal cash, and product snapshots.

zh: 打开养老金账户明细，分别读内部可投资余额、产品市值和账户总资产，不把三项相加。
已有快照只核对持仓；实际从银行充值才点“记录实际充值”，确认已到账且未被两个余额重复包含。
内部买入选已有或新产品、种类和分类，填实际成交额、费用、日期，并确认平台已完成。
赎回选择全部或部分；部分赎回核对对应账面和成本，净回款留在该养老金内。
调整分类只改分类，不重写金额；展开账户内投资记录，检查普通银行及年度实缴没有因内部交易变化。
en: Read internal cash, product value, and total account assets separately; do not sum all three.
Use snapshot review for existing holdings. Use 记录实际充值 only for an actual bank-funded contribution not already covered by either balance.
For an internal purchase, select or add a product/type/classification, enter completed consideration, fees, and date, and confirm platform completion.
For redemption choose all or part; partial redemption needs the relevant carrying amount and cost. Net proceeds stay inside the pension.
Classification changes affect classification only. Review internal trade history and verify that ordinary cash and annual contributions did not change.

result.zh: 内部买卖不消耗新的年度缴费额度，不把赎回款提到普通银行。受限资金不用于日常预算备款，账户与底层产品不重复统计。
result.en: Internal trades do not consume new annual contribution allowance or withdraw proceeds to ordinary cash. Restricted assets are excluded from daily budget funding and are not double-counted.

note.zh: 领取年龄是个人规划，不能当法定资格或自动解锁指令。现有养老金图保留旧个人参数来源，本版不公开；按C29/C30复演并补清洁图。
note.en: A planned withdrawal age is not legal eligibility or an automatic unlock instruction. Existing pension images retain older personal-input provenance and are excluded; use C29/C30 to recapture clean examples.

title.zh: 消费规划、费用核对与逐人审批
title.en: Spending plans, cost review, and individual approval

entry.zh: ChatGPT → 保存预算草稿；研究记录 → 采用并提交家庭审批；预算详情
entry.en: ChatGPT → budget draft; Research records → adopt for approval; budget details

prerequisite.zh: 已连接正确家庭，至少两位演示登录成员可验证多人审批。
prerequisite.en: Correct household connection; at least two demo signed-in members for multi-user approval.

zh: 说明日期、人数、偏好、上限及已有权益，先让ChatGPT读取家庭依据，再生成带来源和未知项的计划。
要求保存预算草稿并回读；回研究记录按类型/关键词找到并展开。
逐项核对数量、单价、商家、费用来源及行程；未知费用保留未知，修改后重新确认。
选择“采用并提交家庭审批”，打开预算详情；发给家人的审批链接只私下分享。
每位有效登录成员核对同一当前版本并提交本人意见；修改金额/日期/归属后重新审批。
en: Describe dates, party size, preferences, limits, and existing benefits. Have ChatGPT read household context before producing sourced costs and unknowns.
Ask it to save and read back the budget draft; locate it in Research records.
Check quantities, prices, merchants, source categories, and itinerary. Preserve unknown costs and reconfirm edits.
Choose 采用并提交家庭审批, open plan details, and share the approval link privately.
Every active signed-in member reviews the current version and submits their own opinion. Changes restart approval.

result.zh: 全体同意才进入正式预算与日历；草稿保存、采用、审批和到期均不自动扣现金。费用清单合计必须一致。
result.en: Only unanimous approval creates the formal budget/calendar entry. Draft submission, adoption, approval, and due dates never automatically debit cash. Cost totals must agree.

note.zh: 来源报价不代表库存/成交；修改商家或计价条件后重核来源，不能只改小计继续沿用旧报价。
note.en: A sourced quote is not inventory or execution. Recheck evidence after merchant or pricing-condition changes rather than reusing an old quote.

title.zh: 实付、预付款、消费冲抵、退款与现金流水
title.en: Payments, prepayments, settlement, refunds, and cashflow

entry.zh: 预算详情 → 记录实际消费；现金流水 → 记实际收支/从图片整理；研究记录 → 实际流水草稿
entry.en: Plan details → actual expense; Cashflow → actual entries/images; Research records → cashflow drafts

prerequisite.zh: 实际事实已核对，明确付款成员、账户、日期、金额与余额覆盖。
prerequisite.en: Verified real-world event with an explicit paying member, account, date, amount, and snapshot coverage.

zh: 已审批计划实际付款：在详情选“实际消费已付款”，填本次实付而非预算总额，选成员/账户和实际日期，确认入账。
提前付款：选“预订预付款已扣款”；实际消费时选“预付款已实际消费”并关联原预付款。
未消费部分已退款：选“预付款退款已到账”，核对原预付款和原账户，只退可退余额。
不关联计划的实际收支从现金流水“记实际收支”或图片草稿开始；图片先做候选校对和排重，再确认。
已有余额覆盖的历史选择“已包含”，匹配余额核实日期；无法确认就保留草稿。采用后回流水及资产核对，结果不明先查原记录。
en: For an approved plan, choose 实际消费已付款, enter this actual payment rather than the budget total, and confirm the member/account/date.
For advance payment choose 预订预付款已扣款. Later consume it with 预付款已实际消费 linked to the original prepayment.
For a received refund of unused prepayment, select 预付款退款已到账 and verify the original payment/account and refundable remainder.
Start unrelated actual income/expenses with 记实际收支 or an image draft. Images require candidate review and deduplication first.
For history already covered by a balance, choose covered and match the snapshot date. Leave uncertainty as a draft; after adoption inspect cashflow and assets before retrying.

result.zh: 预付款先减银行、增预付资产；消费冲抵不再扣银行；退款只将未消费部分退回原账户。已含余额历史只补记录。
result.en: Prepayment debits cash and creates a prepaid asset. Consumption does not debit cash again. Refunds return only unused amounts to the original account. Covered history adds records without another debit.

note.zh: 贷款本金、证券买卖及内部转账使用专用入口。未来工资、预计收益、未付款计划和重复图片都不能当实际收入/费用。
note.en: Use dedicated flows for loan principal, securities, and transfers. Future wages, forecast returns, unpaid plans, and duplicate images are not actual income/expenses.

title.zh: 日历、跨日计划、投资复核与取消
title.en: Calendar, multi-day plans, investment follow-ups, and cancellation

entry.zh: 生活日历 → 月/周、筛选、当天安排与原计划详情
entry.en: 生活日历 (Calendar) → month/week, filters, selected day, plan details

prerequisite.zh: 已有批准计划或采用的投资复核；日期未全时列待排期。
prerequisite.en: An approved plan or adopted investment follow-up; incomplete dates remain unscheduled.

zh: 在整月/本周间切换，选择月份和安排类型，再选某日查看当天事项。
打开计划详情核对整个预算与当日行程；跨日出现不代表每天新增一份预算。
要调整消费计划选择“到ChatGPT调整”，保持原计划关联，采用新版后重新审批。
投资研究补复核日期和条件后点“同步复核到日历”；核对“未交易”标识。
取消时核对计划版本和已发生款项，确认后看取消提示；如提示已取消但列表未刷新，按提示刷新核对，不重复取消或退款。
en: Switch month/week views, choose a month and arrangement filter, then select a day.
Open details and distinguish the full budget from that day’s itinerary. Multi-day display does not create daily copies of the budget.
Use 到ChatGPT调整 for consumption changes, preserving the original plan link; a new adopted version needs approval.
Add investment follow-up dates/conditions and choose 同步复核到日历; verify the unexecuted-trade label.
Before cancellation check the version and actual payments. If cancellation succeeded but refresh failed, refresh and inspect rather than repeating cancellation or refund.

result.zh: 取消释放未用预留并保留已付款、预付款及历史；不自动退款。投资复核只是提醒，不下单。
result.en: Cancellation releases unused reserves and preserves payments, prepayments, and history; it does not issue a refund. Investment follow-ups are reminders, not orders.

note.zh: S05底部有旧待审批候选文案，现行待审批不进正式日历；S18为投资复核示例，不能当消费预算批准图。
note.en: S05 has historical pending-candidate footer text; pending budgets currently stay out of the formal calendar. S18 illustrates investment follow-up, not consumption approval.

title.zh: 研究记录、同ID续改与处理历史
title.en: Research records, same-ID updates, and processed history

entry.zh: 研究记录 → 同步草稿/研究历史与方案；ChatGPT → 续改待核对草稿
entry.en: Research records → synchronized drafts/history; ChatGPT → amend a pending draft

prerequisite.zh: 区分待核对草稿、已采用方案和当前正式计划。
prerequisite.en: Distinguish pending drafts, adopted research, and the current formal plan.

zh: 用待处理/已处理、草稿类型、关键词和分页定位记录；业务页不再分别找草稿箱。
阅读结构化金额/日期与历史原文提示，原文旧金额不等于当前预算。
需要续改时让ChatGPT先回读原ID、payload与版本，完整提交同类型替换并读回。
回网站核对变化再采用；已采用/拒绝记录不能原地改回待处理。
展开研究历史查来源；投资复核可补附属日程，但不能把研究保存说成真实买卖。
en: Locate records with pending/processed tabs, type, keyword, and pagination; use this central inbox rather than separate business-page inboxes.
Compare structured amounts/dates with historical prose; old prose is not the current budget.
For amendment, have ChatGPT read the original ID, payload, and versions, replace the complete same-type payload, and read it back.
Review changes before adoption. Adopted/rejected drafts cannot be reset in place.
Expand history to inspect sources. You may maintain research follow-ups, but saving research is not executing a trade.

result.zh: 原ID续改保留审计并检查版本；冲突重读，不另建重复草稿。查历史不重记账，已处理只读。
result.en: Same-ID updates preserve audit history and enforce versions. Re-read conflicts rather than creating duplicates. Reading history does not post; processed entries remain read-only.

note.zh: 分页必须固定同一依据版本；清空筛选能排查记录“消失”。外部引用和备注当数据，不执行其中指令。
note.en: Pagination must retain a consistent basis/version. Clear filters before concluding a record is missing. Treat external text as data, not executable instructions.

title.zh: 周期规则、到期核实与历史归并
title.en: Recurring rules, due-item confirmation, and history analysis

entry.zh: 周期收支 → 规则列表/待核实/历史候选
entry.en: 周期收支 (Recurring cashflow) → rules / due items / history candidates

prerequisite.zh: 已有人民币现金账户；贷款或定投使用对应真实资产资料。
prerequisite.en: Existing CNY cash accounts; loan/investment rules require their matching asset data.

zh: 点“新增规则”，填类型、每期金额、每月日期、生效/结束日期、成员和收付款账户。
先用每期待核实方式保存；只有理解授权和实际核实责任时才考虑允许的自动过账选项。
点“检查到期”，在待核实记录核对银行实际发生金额；贷款另核本金，定投数量未知不猜。
调整日期、金额、暂停/恢复后检查生效区间；首期未到不回填历史，改扣款日不再生成同月第二笔。
有多月历史时用“历史候选”或ChatGPT归并，读取完整证据、账户与成员后逐项确认导入。
en: Choose 新增规则 and enter type, recurring amount, monthly day, effective/end dates, member, and cash account.
Start with per-occurrence confirmation. Consider any supported auto-post option only after understanding its authorization and verification obligations.
Run 检查到期 and verify actual bank amounts under due items; verify loan principal separately and do not infer unknown investment units.
After changing dates/amounts or pause status, check effective periods. Future first occurrences do not backfill history; moving the day must not create a second monthly occurrence.
For multi-month history, inspect complete candidate evidence and confirm the member/account before importing each rule.

result.zh: 规则卡片是启用规则的常规月合计，不等于某月实际或预测。已确认分录才增加实际积累，未入账排期单列。
result.en: Rule cards show the regular monthly total of active rules, not a month’s actuals or forecast. Only posted entries affect actual accumulation; pending schedules remain separate.

note.zh: S14是新增规则表单；S15展示月报中的周期联动，不是规则列表截图。到期检查不等于银行已到账。
note.en: S14 is the rule form; S15 is recurring information within the monthly report, not the rule list. A due check does not prove a bank receipt.

title.zh: 现金预测、年度预算与备款缺口
title.en: Cash forecasts, annual budgets, and funding gaps

entry.zh: 现金预测；预算与大型支出 → 年度预算
entry.en: 现金预测 (Forecast); Budgets → 年度预算 (Annual budget)

prerequisite.zh: 已核对当前现金、周期规则、计划日期和实际付款。
prerequisite.en: Reviewed cash snapshots, recurring rules, plan dates, and actual payments.

zh: 在现金预测选择月份，逐列查看预计收入、周期支出、大型支出尚需、待审批风险和期末现金。
将预测与规则生效日对照，确认没有把未来首期提前算入；核对未知生活费和未录收入的限制。
到预算页切“年度预算”，选择年度，看预算、净付款、已消费与尚需金额，不把它们叠加为支出。
从年度关联计划进入原详情核对；日期不完整的计划先补日期，取消/完成计划历史仍保留。
期末现金为负时回查计划和规则，不自动变现证券或降低真实账户余额来“修正”预测。
en: Select a forecast month and inspect income, recurring outflows, outstanding plan funding, pending-approval risk, and closing cash.
Compare effective dates; future first occurrences must not be pulled forward. Note omitted unknown living costs and unrecorded income.
In Annual budget, choose the year and separate budgets, net payments, consumption, and outstanding needs instead of adding them as expenses.
Open linked plans for reconciliation; resolve missing dates. Completed/cancelled plan history remains stored.
If forecast cash is negative, inspect inputs; do not silently sell securities or alter real balances to repair the forecast.

result.zh: 预测起点是可用人民币银行现金，证券、房产、养老金不当现金；预留、已付与预付不重复扣。预测不生成交易。
result.en: Spendable CNY bank cash is the starting point. Securities, property, and pensions are not cash; reserves/payments/prepayments are not deducted twice. Forecasting posts nothing.

note.zh: 截图待补：S15含月报预测摘要，可识别实际/预计分层，但不是独立现金预测页或年度预算页的截图。
note.en: Screenshot gap: S15 includes a report forecast summary, not the separate forecast or annual-budget screen.

title.zh: 月报、不可变归档与ChatGPT复盘
title.en: Monthly reports, immutable archives, and ChatGPT review

entry.zh: 月度报告 → 月份/报告版本/保存本月报告
entry.en: 月度报告 (Monthly report) → month / version / save

prerequisite.zh: 已有本站记录；真实银行账单可能比本站范围更大。
prerequisite.en: Recorded app transactions; real bank history may extend beyond the app.

zh: 选择月份和“最新账目预览”，分别读确认收入、费用、现金净流量和净资产增减。
展开按成员/原币、关键流水与资产负债核对，检查开账、转账、证券本金和还贷本金的分类。
看实际积累与未入账周期预计，历史缺期初时保留提示，不把开账当收益。
核对后点“保存本月报告”；切换“报告版本”查看已保存第N版。
让ChatGPT按该月完整依据生成总结草稿；回站点核对，依据已变化时重新读取后生成，再采用。
en: Choose a month and 最新账目预览. Read income, expense, business cashflow, and net-worth change separately.
Expand member/original-currency details, key transactions, and asset/liability reconciliation; check opening balances, transfers, securities principal, and loan principal.
Separate actual accumulation from pending recurring forecasts and preserve unknown-opening-history warnings.
Choose 保存本月报告, then use 报告版本 to inspect an archived version.
Ask ChatGPT for a review grounded in the complete monthly context. If its basis changed, regenerate before adoption.

result.zh: 归档保存当时数据，不被后来补账改写；新预览/新版本可变化，旧版本不变。同月多版本年度汇总只能按选定规则取一份。
result.en: An archive preserves its original data. New previews/versions may change while earlier versions remain unchanged. Annual totals must not sum multiple versions of the same month.

note.zh: 保存报告不是生成银行对账单，月总结不改账。S13/S16为同月不同归档版本演示，不是一张图证明所有计算。
note.en: Saving a report does not create a bank statement; narrative reviews do not post. S13/S16 illustrate different archives, not complete calculation evidence.

title.zh: 会员权益、有效期与出行增量成本
title.en: Membership validity and incremental trip costs

entry.zh: 头像 → 会员权益；日历 → 会员权益
entry.en: Avatar or Calendar → 会员权益 (Membership benefits)

prerequisite.zh: 管理员维护，家人只读；不录卡号、证件或密码。
prerequisite.en: Administrator edits; members read. Never store card numbers, identity documents, or passwords.

zh: 点“新增会员权益”，填名称、品牌、种类、归属、已知等级、覆盖人数和可选已购成本。
选择未激活/已生效/待核实，填真实生效日期、平台明确到期日或有效天数，未知不勾“无固定到期日”。
逐条填权益、限制和额外费用，区分每人/每车/每次，记录价格依据与核对日期。
保存后按出行日期、种类、名称与归属筛选；停用时保留记录。
规划旅行前让ChatGPT读取会员，计算本次新增支出；未覆盖的人数、车辆、预约和餐饮另核价。
en: Choose 新增会员权益 and enter name, brand, type, owner, known tier, covered people, and optional historical cost.
Select activation status and actual start/platform expiry or duration. Do not mark “no expiry” simply because it is unknown.
Add benefits, restrictions, and extra charges with per-person/car/visit units, evidence type, and checked date.
Save and filter by travel date/type/name/owner; deactivate without deleting history.
Before planning, ask ChatGPT to read benefits and calculate incremental trip costs, including uncovered people, vehicles, reservations, and meals.

result.zh: 会员维护不扣银行、不生成资产或消费。已购成本不再次计入本次出游；未知酒店等级不猜折扣，推算有效期要标注。
result.en: Membership maintenance does not debit cash or create assets/expenses. Do not charge sunk purchase cost to a new trip. Unknown hotel tiers yield no invented discount; derived expiry is labeled.

note.zh: 截图待补：现有会员样本沿用旧个人购卡参数，不纳入公开演示。按C31独立构造权益后再采图。
note.en: Screenshot gap: existing membership samples reuse earlier personal purchase parameters and are excluded. Recapture with independent C31 inputs.

title.zh: 票据附件、重试、登出与常见故障
title.en: Attachments, retries, sign-out, and common recovery

entry.zh: 计划详情 → 票据与附件；顶部刷新/头像 → 退出登录
entry.en: Plan details → 票据与附件; refresh/avatar → sign out

prerequisite.zh: 附件加密已配置；仅使用演示文件。保存结果不明时先核查原请求。
prerequisite.en: Attachment encryption configured; demo files only. Resolve uncertain save results before retrying.

zh: 在计划详情选PDF/PNG/JPEG/WebP票据，核对预览、名称、大小与计划，明确勾选私密保存后提交。
单份不超过512KB、每计划最多20份；成功后核对列表和文件选择重置，再决定下一份。
提示已保存但列表刷新失败时先刷新；连接中断结果不明时检查原结果，不换文件后盲目重传。
版本冲突先重读，401重新登录，403检查家庭/角色；余额覆盖不明保留草稿，重复疑似项先查历史。
结束演示时隐藏金额并从头像“退出登录”；共享截图前检查姓名、金额、URL、邀请和附件内容。
en: Choose a PDF/PNG/JPEG/WebP in plan details, review its preview/name/size/plan, explicitly confirm private storage, then save.
Limits are512KB per file and20 per plan. After success inspect the list and cleared selection before the next file.
If saved but refresh failed, refresh first. For an interrupted unknown result, inspect the original request before changing files and resubmitting.
Re-read version conflicts, sign in after401, and check household/role after403. Keep uncertain balance coverage as a draft and investigate suspected duplicates.
Hide amounts and sign out via the avatar after the demo. Inspect names, amounts, URLs, invitations, and receipt content before sharing screenshots.

result.zh: 附件私密加密存储，与研究图片引用不同；归档附件保留历史。安全重试不应多存一份，预览不代表已上传成功。
result.en: Attachments are private encrypted files, separate from research image references. Archiving preserves history. Safe retries must not create extra files; a preview does not prove upload success.

note.zh: S17为隔离附件组件画面，不是生产上传证据。未配置密钥时停止保存并由部署维护者安全配置，不在聊天粘贴密钥。
note.en: S17 is an isolated attachment-component image, not production upload evidence. If encryption is unconfigured, stop and have the deployment maintainer configure it securely; never paste keys into chat.
